创建、编辑和制作动画——全部在一个智能生成管道中完成。

适合谁：希望在 ComfyUI 中使用此管道而无需从头开始组装节点的创建者。不适合：零调整的一键结果 - 您仍然可以选择输入、提示和设置。

在 RunComfy 上打开预加载的工作流程

在 RunComfy（浏览器）上打开预加载的工作流程

为什么首先选择 RunComfy
- 更少的丢失节点意外— 在本地镜像之前在托管环境中运行该图。
- GPU 快速试用— 如果您的本地 VRAM 或安装时间是瓶颈，则很有用。
- 与发布的 JSON 匹配— 该 zip 遵循与您可以在 RunComfy 上打开的相同的可运行工作流程。

当下载本地 ComfyUI 有意义时— 您希望完全控制磁盘上的模型、批处理脚本或离线运行。

使用方法（本地ComfyUI）
1. 在标记的加载器节点中加载输入（图像/视频/音频）。
2、设置提示、分辨率、种子；从短暂的试运行开始。
3. 从图中所示的保存/写入节点导出。

期望— 第一次运行可能会拉动大重量;云运行可能需要免费的 RunComfy 帐户.

概述

这种统一的 Capybara 设置专为需要效率和一致性的创作者而设计，可实现文本到图像、图像编辑和视频任务之间的无缝转换。您可以在一个集成管道中使用提示生成视觉效果、为其设置动画或优化视频。该模板系列支持优化的分辨率和纵横比，以实现可靠的质量。它基于 Capybara v0.1 构建，可确保快速实验和连贯的视觉效果。非常适合希望在单一环境中处理图像和视频工作流程的艺术家。

重要节点：

Comfyui Capybara ComfyUI 工作流程中的关键节点

  • 图像编辑（水豚 v0.1）（＃103）

  • 一个紧凑的、基于指令的编辑器，可在全局应用文本编辑的同时使用视觉功能保留结构。调整文本提示描述什么应该改变，什么必须保留，然后使用步骤为了质量/平滑度和cfg平衡提示强度与源图像。增加步骤了解更多详情；中等cfg值通常使编辑保持忠实。

  • 混源Video15ImageToVideo（＃115）

  • 从静态到动态的桥梁以及基于提示的视频编辑背后的引擎。它会根据您的提示创建一个简短的潜在序列，并在提供时创建一个起始图像。调音长度持续时间和宽度/高度匹配预设；较大的尺寸会增加细节并缩短渲染时间。该节点是图像到视频和视频编辑组的支柱，利用 HunyuanVideo 设计实现稳定的时间生成，同时 Capybara 处理去噪。

  • VHS_VideoCombine（＃145）

  • 将生成的帧转换为 MP4 的终结器。使用帧率控制运动节奏和crf以质量换取文件大小。较低crf产生更高质量但更大的文件；保持跨项目的一致性，以便您的 Capybara ComfyUI 工作流输出具有统一的外观。

注释

水豚 ComfyUI 工作流程 v0.1 |四合一图像和视频生成器— 参见舒适运行页面了解最新的节点要求。

Create, edit, and animate — all in one smart generation pipeline.

Who it's for:creators who want this pipeline in ComfyUI without assembling nodes from scratch.Not for:one-click results with zero tuning — you still choose inputs, prompts, and settings.

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy

Open preloaded workflow on RunComfy (browser)

Why RunComfy first
- Fewer missing-node surprises— run the graph in a managed environment before you mirror it locally.
- Quick GPU tryout— useful if your local VRAM or install time is the bottleneck.
- Matches the published JSON— the zip follows the same runnable workflow you can open on RunComfy.

When downloading for local ComfyUI makes sense— you want full control over models on disk, batch scripting, or offline runs.

How to use (local ComfyUI)
1. Load inputs (images/video/audio) in the marked loader nodes.
2. Set prompts, resolution, and seeds; start with a short test run.
3. Export from the Save / Write nodes shown in the graph.

Expectations— First run may pulllarge weights; cloud runs may require afree RunComfy account.

Overview

Designed for creators who need efficiency and consistency, this unified Capybara setup enables seamless transitions between text-to-image, image editing, and video tasks. You can generate visuals, animate them, or refine videos using prompts in one integrated pipeline. The template family supports optimized resolutions and aspect ratios for reliable quality. Built on Capybara v0.1, it ensures fast experimentation and coherent visuals. Perfect for artists looking to handle image and video workflows within a single environment.

Important nodes:

Key nodes in Comfyui Capybara ComfyUI Workflow

  • Image Edit (Capybara v0.1)(#103)

  • A compact, instruction‑based editor that preserves structure using vision features while applying your text edit globally. Adjust thetextprompt to describe what should change and what must stay, then usestepsfor quality/smoothness andcfgto balance prompt strength against the source image. Increasestepsfor more detail; moderatecfgvalues usually keep edits faithful.

  • HunyuanVideo15ImageToVideo(#115)

  • The bridge from stills to motion and the engine behind prompt‑based video edits. It creates a short latent sequence conditioned on your prompt and, when provided, a start image. Tunelengthfor duration andwidth/heightto match a preset; larger sizes increase detail and render time. This node is the backbone of both the Image‑to‑Video and Video Edit groups, leveraging the HunyuanVideo design for stable temporal generation while Capybara handles denoising.

  • VHS_VideoCombine(#145)

  • The finalizer that turns generated frames into an MP4. Useframe_rateto control motion cadence andcrfto trade quality for file size. Lowercrfyields higher quality but bigger files; keep it consistent across projects so your Capybara ComfyUI Workflow outputs have a uniform look.

Notes

Capybara ComfyUI Workflow v0.1 | 4-in-1 Image and Video Generator— seeRunComfy pagefor the latest node requirements.
